name: notionmemory
description: Notion second-brain skills for coding agents: calendar, memory, templates, library, and settings. Backed by the notionmemory Python CLI (pipx install notionmemory).

hooks.command: command -v notionmemory >/dev/null 2>&1 && notionmemory hook session-start || true
command -v notionmemory >/dev/null 2>&1 && notionmemory hook save-reminder || true
command -v notionmemory >/dev/null 2>&1 && notionmemory hook session-stop || true
command -v notionmemory >/dev/null 2>&1 && notionmemory hook user-prompt || true
